isolated_lifecycle_composition.persistence: Existing OneRequestLifecycleProbe compact atomic journal; NEW/PENDING/ATTEMPTED/terminal states remain crash-safe and non-retryable.
isolated_lifecycle_composition.request: Existing build_birdeye_ohlcv_request canonical V3 MCAP request; creation timestamp is retained only as non-provider request context.
isolated_lifecycle_composition.normalization: Existing shared normalize_partial_birdeye_mcap_ohlcv; no aliases or provider parsing duplicated.
isolated_lifecycle_composition.projection: Existing watchtower_price_fact_contract now has a compact observed-only projection for strict post-peak trough, recovery, last observed close, and coverage labels.
isolated_lifecycle_composition.canonical_database: No SQLite lifecycle facts or observations are read or written by the composition.

reused_components: Birdeye V3 request builder and production binding
Existing one-request runtime gate, shared-budget admission, atomic journal, storage bounds, and no-repeat contract

new_code_justification.missing: The established reducer exposed observed peak/crossings and peak-to-close drawdown but did not expose strict peak-to-subsequent-trough, post-trough recovery, observed last close, or request-window coverage labels.
new_code_justification.minimal_change: One function in the existing reducer and one compact call-site integration. No client, executor, ledger, scheduler, database, or evidence framework was added.

lifecycle_metrics.creation_to_maximum: non-negative seconds from supplied creation timestamp
lifecycle_metrics.drawdown: only from observed peak to a strictly later observed trough; same-candle order is never inferred
lifecycle_metrics.recovery: highest observed high strictly after the observed trough, or explicit unavailable state
lifecycle_metrics.last_observed: last validated candle close and timestamp; never terminal valuation
lifecycle_metrics.coverage: CONTIGUOUS_REQUESTED_WINDOW only when endpoints and internal interval gaps support it; otherwise PARTIAL_OBSERVED_WINDOW or NO_VALID_CANDLES

provider_request_bounds.existing_execution_contract: Exactly one authorization, one budget admission, one transport attempt, no pagination, fallback, or automatic retry.
provider_request_bounds.cohort_execution: Not implemented or authorized. Any future multi-request lifecycle work requires a separate finite authorization and explicit composition review.

regression: 25 focused provider-free tests passed, including isolated metrics, crash/no-repeat, shared normalizer, budget-order fixture, historical executor, terminal adapter, and lifecycle-accuracy tests.
next_gate: Stop before paid acquisition. The isolated one-request lifecycle composition is qualified; any request needs separate explicit authorization and cannot target terminal ranks 49, 42, or 44.
